title: Chapter 647 - 647 System; Protagonist?
content:
Chapter 647 - 647 System; Protagonist?

Chapter 647 - 647 System; Protagonist?

647 System; Protagonist?

In fact…

Not only did Xia Xue’s heartbeat speed up, but many female students in the class also had their eyes lit up slightly. Their heartbeats kept speeding up.

“So handsome!”

“Our class finally has a handsome guy.”

” Lin Fan, what a nice name!”

“Hello, handsome!”

…

With Lin Fan’s hearing ability, he easily heard everyone’s words.

However, he did not care at all. He looked straight at Xia Xue’s position.

“Hello, everyone. My name is Lin Fan.”

Qin Chuan nodded and said, “Lin Fan, find an empty seat and sit down.”

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

Lin Fan strode forward.

The hearts of the ladies sitting far away kept racing.

But soon, Lin Fan stopped and stopped beside Xia Xue. He smiled and said, “Can I sit here?”

Xia Xue stuttered, “S-Sure.”

Lin Fan sat down.

When the ladies nearby saw this, they sighed in their hearts.

They regretted not sitting in the front today.

Perhaps, Lin Fan would have sat at the same table as them.

Qin Chuan did not care where Lin Fan sat.

He cleared his throat and said, “Since all the students are here, I’ll reveal the school’s announcement.”

After saying that, he clicked on the whiteboard behind him.

Then, a paragraph of bold text immediately appeared on the whiteboard.

[Notice: In order to promote the students’ spirit of exploration of the forbidden area, stimulate and develop their special abilities, and enhance their overall quality, all second-year students will enter the forbidden area for a week of exploration.]

The classroom was soon filled with discussions.

“We’re going to explore the forbidden area so soon?”

“I wonder if I can activate my special ability.”

“I wish I could have the special ability to fly. That feeling is great.”

“Fly? That’s too difficult.”

…

“This is the situation,” Qin Chuan pressed his hands together and said.

“Everyone can go back and pack your luggage now. Just come to the classroom at 9 AM tomorrow.

“Does anyone have any questions? Or are you unable to participate due to special reasons such as illness or injury? You can raise your hand.”

The students looked at each other, but none of them raised their hands.

After all, this was a chance to enter the forbidden area.

No one wanted to miss it easily.

“Alright, that’s it, then. School’s over.”

Qin Chuan was very decisive. After saying that, he strode out.

The students were worried, happy, afraid, and excited…They had different thoughts.

After a while, they slowly left the classroom.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

All the students carried huge backpacks and arrived at the classroom early.

“I heard that there’s a very powerful fruit in the forbidden area. Eating one can increase one’s strength by a few hundred pounds’ worth.”

“A few hundred pounds’ worth of strength is nothing. I heard that there’s another type of water there. Drinking a drop of it can directly turn you into an A-class expert!”

“I’m not too interested in becoming stronger. I only hope to find perfect gold! It seemed like one piece can fetch a price of tens of millions of World Coins!”

…

The more the students discussed, the more their eyes lit up.

It was as if those special fruits, liquids, and perfect gold were all in front of them. They could easily obtain them with a casual raise of their hands.

Xia Xue just sat quietly in her seat, but her beautiful eyes were faintly looking at the door. It was as if she was looking forward to something.

At this moment, crisp footsteps sounded from outside the corridor.

Then, a tall and handsome figure slowly walked in.

It was Lin Fan!

Lin Fan did not hesitate at all and sat down next to Xia Xue.

Xia Xue’s pretty face could not help but blush slightly.

Lin Fan sat beside her again.

Some of the women around sighed.

A crisp bell rang in Jiangbei University.

Soon, Qin Chuan, who was wearing a white shirt, walked in like yesterday.

He looked around at everyone and said, “Not bad, everyone is here on time. Then, let’s set off now!”

At this moment, there were many hover buses parked on the wide field.

Groups of second-year students lined up under the teacher’s instructions and walked toward the buses.

It had to be said that the buses from a thousand years later was indeed not bad. The seats were wrapped in leather, there was a huge high-definition display screen, and cool ambiance lights…

The one-hour drive did not make them feel tired at all. On the contrary, it made the students feel better.

When the bus opened its doors, they saw a tall iron net. Inside the iron net was an endless huge forest.

A man dressed in black strode over.

Qin Chuan nodded at him and handed him a card.

The machine in the black-clothed man’s hand let out a soft sound. “Verification successful, Qin Chuan.”

“There are a total of 23 people from Class 2011 who will be entering Forbidden Area No. 31 this time,” Qin Chuan said.

“Alright,” the man in black said.

He clicked on the foldable display screen in his hand and opened the iron gate behind him.

“Students, let me remind you again. The outer perimeter of the forbidden area refers to the area within 100 kilometers of the forbidden area! Don’t enter the central region 100 kilometers away. It’s very dangerous there. Your mission is to live in the outer region for seven days!

“All of your phones have emergency buttons. If you encounter danger, press it quickly. We will get someone to rush to you as soon as possible.”
